hpi: This case highlights the importance of recognizing the signs and symptoms of Myasthenia Gravis, a neuromuscular disorder characterized by weakness and rapid fatigue of voluntary muscles. Early diagnosis and appropriate management are crucial to improve patient outcomes. Key diagnostic tests include CT imaging of the chest to assess for thymoma and electromyography to evaluate neuromuscular transmission.
